checked_against: quoted_span: 'newly constructed multiple dwellings shall be exempt from any local rent control ordinances for a period of 30 years following completion of construction of the building.'
reason: Exempt for the first 30 years means local rent control covers the building only from age 30, so coverage_conditions.min_building_age_years = 30 matches the span.

checked_against: quoted_span: 'Beginning February 2, 2026, a landlord can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.'
reason: The text states a start date and no end of period; valid_until is never guessed, so the rule can still apply after 2026-06-30 (unlike r-0067).

checked_against: DX01: 'This Ordinance shall take effect immediately upon passage and publication as provided by law.'
reason: Passage (2025-07-09) and publication are both required; the publication date is not in the text. Numbering discrepancy (158-2 vs 154-8) kept in conflict_note.
